title: ReverseUtility
description: A simple Paper plugins that add reverse crafting recipes to Minecraft.
body:
# Reverse

ReverseUtility is a Minecraft plugin for PaperMC/Spigot that adds shapeless crafting recipes allowing players to uncraft storage blocks back into their base items.

![ReverseQuartz Recipe⁠](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a56dff3920059c82a2e7db61ba727c42c0f37b96.png)

![ReverseQuartz Recipe⁠](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f23e64a5e9aad2f664e9ae20fc81bb12ef76ce24.png)

## Requirements

- Java 8 or later (Depending on your Minecraft server version, e.g., Java 21 for 1.21+)
- Minecraft server: PaperMC or Spigot version 1.13 or later

## Features

- Craft 4 Nether Quartz from 1 Quartz Block
- Craft 4 Amethyst Shards from 1 Amethyst Block on supported server versions
- Craft 4 Honeycomb from 1 Honeycomb Block on supported server versions
- Lightweight and easy to use
- No additional configuration required

## Installation

1. Download the compiled `ReverseUtility.jar` file from the **Versions** tab on this page.
2. Copy the `.jar` file into your Minecraft server's `plugins` directory.
3. Restart or reload your Minecraft server.
4. Test the recipes by placing supported blocks in any crafting grid—you should receive their corresponding materials.
